data.case_title: Health insurer requests additional documents for ER claim
data.explanation: Your student health insurer, Example Student Health Plan, needs an itemized bill and proof of payment for your emergency room visit on August 21, 2026 before it can process your claim. Gather these documents from the hospital/clinic and send them to the insurer so they arrive by the deadline shown. If they don't receive the documents in time, they will close the claim and you may have to pay the ER bill yourself or file a new claim later.
